title: Migration --dry-run prints per-user diff in expected format
preconds: Test tenant with users on all 13 legacy roles. CRP-BE-10 migration command available.
steps:
1. Run the migration command with --dry-run flag.
2. Capture stdout.
3. Verify no DB rows were modified (compare user.role_v2_id before/after by querying the DB or via app).
4. Inspect the dry-run output format.
5. Confirm each line has: user email, ' | ', old legacy role, '→', new system role, ' | ', atom count before, '→', atom count after.
6. Spot-check 5 users against the canonical mapping in tech plan §4g.
expected:
Step 3: No DB rows modified.
Step 5: Output format matches 'email | old→new | atom-count before→after'.
Step 6: All 5 spot-checked mappings match the canonical table.
